test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Public health programmes enhance access to life-saving interventions and services. Which scheme aims to provide free health coverage to 50 crore beneficiaries in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayushman Bharat - PMJAY**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)** is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme launched by the Government of India in 2018.
 
• The scheme aims to provide free health insurance coverage of **up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year**, targeting economically vulnerable populations based on the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) database.
 
• It covers secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across public and private empanelled hospitals, ensuring access to life-saving interventions and services.
 
• AB-PMJAY benefits approximately **50 crore beneficiaries**, addressing healthcare inequalities in India.
 
• The scheme is fully financed by the Government of India and contributes to achieving universal health coverage by reducing out-of-pocket healthcare expenses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)**

 
 
• Launched in February 2019, this scheme provides income support to farmers to ensure their financial security and well-being.
 
• Under PM-KISAN, eligible farmers receive **Rs. 6,000 annually** in three equal installments directly into their bank accounts.
 
• The scheme targets farmers with landholdings up to 2 hectares and aims to reduce the financial burden on small and marginal farmers.
 
 
 
• **National Rural Health Mission (NRHM)**
 
 
• NRHM was launched in 2005 under the National Health Mission (NHM) to improve healthcare delivery in rural areas.
 
• It focuses on strengthening public health systems, enhancing healthcare infrastructure, and reducing maternal and child mortality rates.
 
• Key initiatives under NRHM include **Janani Suraksha Yojana**, Accredited Social Health Activists (ASHAs), and village health sanitation committees.
 
 
 
• **Ujjwala Yojana**
 
 
• Launched in 2016, Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) aims to provide **free LPG connections** to women belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
 
• The scheme addresses health hazards caused by traditional cooking methods using firewood and aims to promote cleaner cooking fuel in rural India.
 
• As of 2023, over 9 crore LPG connections have been distributed under PMUY.
